scope_statement: Add a deterministic coverage-gate evaluator over existing PRD, accepted ADR, TDD, and traceability artifacts without generating briefs, mutating artifacts, executing models, running validation commands on behalf of the user, or dispatching work.

commands: idiom tool context_pack --input '{"task":"phase 4 coverage gate deterministic checker product workflow PRD ADR TDD brief generation blocker","mode":"plan","limit":12}'
idiom tool context_query --input '{"query":"coverage gate evaluated TDD coverage criteria evidence acceptance EARS BDD FMEA HAZOP mutation product workflow","resolution":"symbol"}'
JSON/JSONL validation for durable impl-0027 artifacts
privacy secret-value scan over durable effort artifacts

privacy_note: report stores only scope, GPT Codex assignment, changed paths, commands, findings summary, and blocker state; it does not store raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, generated briefs, or customer-identifying data
